mandatory_findings.title: Preserve selection on identity-preserving edit, Save and refusal refresh
mandatory_findings.evidence: poll_native_edit replaces scene and unconditionally calls clear_selection for every qualified Answer, regardless of action success. Thus Save and refusal also deselect existing subjects. The production-callback proof starts without an established selection and does not cover retention.
mandatory_findings.authority: FOUNDATION_MANUAL_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT F3: identity-preserving edits retain selection; PM026 selection lifetime.
mandatory_findings.required_correction: Reconcile complete authoritative selection and focus to the refreshed revision, retaining surviving subjects and applying existing retirement/refusal rules. Cancel obsolete workers without treating cancellation as deselection. Extend existing real-design first-edit proof for Move/Save/refusal selection retention.

mandatory_findings.title: Snap the move reference destination rather than the Footprint anchor
mandatory_findings.evidence: destination computes original component position plus cursor delta, then rounds that component anchor to grid. Nonzero grab offsets and off-grid component positions therefore change the intended translation/offset. Existing proof computes its expected position with this same function, so it cannot detect the wrong rule.
mandatory_findings.authority: UVT §2.2.12 immediate reference-point rule and original_position + (destination-reference); foundation F4 exact frame/snap and approved stable cursor-offset preview.
mandatory_findings.required_correction: Use shared checked reference-point snapping; preserve captured original component and cursor reference, complete geometry and exact preview/commit correspondence. Cover off-grid component, nonzero offset and both coordinate signs without deriving expected values from the implementation under test.

mandatory_findings.title: Do not truncate an accepted valid unterminated journal record
mandatory_findings.evidence: read_transaction_journal parses content.lines(), accepting complete TransactionRecord JSON without final newline. Guarded confirmation syncs that visible journal and can promote its linked stage/head. resolve_for_write_with_lease subsequently calls recover_torn_journal_tail before committed-linkage inspection; the helper truncates every unterminated tail, including that valid now accepted record, orphaning authority and destroying journal evidence.
mandatory_findings.authority: PM060 W3 durable/uncertain-outcome reconciliation and committed recovery evidence preservation; foundation F6.
mandatory_findings.required_correction: Recognize and preserve complete/committed unterminated records or refuse ambiguous committed evidence without altering bytes. Recover only provably uncommitted torn tails. Add focused interrupted JSON-before-newline -> guarded confirmation/reopen -> next-write regression verifying no accepted record is removed or duplicated.
